Subject: Welcome to Marble
Body: Hi [Client_name],

I'm happy that you chose me and Marble to help you through this critical matter. I'm looking forward to getting started on your case, and feel confident that we can achieve the best possible outcome.
 
 What to expect next
 I've provided a list of information I'll need from you to get your case started. Once received, I'll begin the drafting process and review it with you in our next meeting.

Timing for cases like this can be hard to predict due to courts, response wait times, and other factors, so we'll want to gather all the necessary items as soon as possible to get your case moving immediately.
 
 What I'll need from you
 To get your case moving, I'll need you to complete some important items before we meet again. Please log in to your Marble Home to:

- Schedule our kickoff call
- Complete your intake form
- Upload required documents
 
 
 What we'll cover in the case kickoff call
 After you provide the required documents and intake form, you'll schedule a case kickoff call. As soon as we receive your information, we start working on your case: reviewing details, gathering background, and preparing drafts where possible. This way by the time we meet, most of the review is already done and we can focus the call on confirming details, answering any final questions, and laying out next steps. The goal is to keep your case moving forward smoothly and efficiently.
 
 How we'll stay in touch
 I will likely not be available for ad-hoc calls as much of my time is spent in court, but you'll get regular updates about your specific case progress from the Marble Assistant in Marble Home.

As your case develops, I'll schedule necessary calls when it's time to walk through important updates or make decisions together. I encourage you to take advantage of all of Marble's resources to get ongoing questions answered in between scheduled calls.

You can always get help using the Marble Assistant for anything from case and administrative questions to tech challenges. If you have an urgent legal question, you can reach out to me and I'll get back to you as soon as I can.
 My main method of communication with clients is email, so please be sure to use this email address when trying to get a hold of me: dana.wh3282@cocounsel.marble.co
 
 A quick recap of our agreed upon services
 As a reminder, Marble works on a pay-per-step model. This means we take your case one step at a time, and each step comes at a fixed price. My role will focus on the specific services defined in your current contract. Should there be any additional legal work required in the future, we’ll discuss additional services at that time.

The services we’re starting with are:

- Marble Resolution Package (with children)

If you need a reminder of what’s included in each service and general timelines, go to your Case Overview page in your Marble Home.
 
 Please know that your matter is important and I'm here to see it through. Let me know if you have any questions about the points above. I'm looking forward to helping you get the outcome you deserve in your case.

Best,
